episodes.synopsis: As dark clouds portend the coming of an invasion force, five warriors arrive to battle the threat.
episodes.title: Shadowland

episodes.synopsis: Talpa dispatches his warlord Anubis to find Mia as a way of drawing out the warriors.
episodes.title: Glory for Anubis

episodes.synopsis: With the warriors scattered across the world, Mia and Ully go in search of Ryo.
episodes.title: Secret of Wildfire

episodes.synopsis: Ryo, Mia and Ully seek help from Mia's grandfather, who suspiciously refuses to help them.
episodes.title: The Search Begins

episodes.synopsis: Mia uses a line from her grandfather's poem to find Sage, but Sekhmet tracks them down.
episodes.title: Halo's Prison

episodes.synopsis: The gang heads to the Sea of Toyama to find Cye, where Ryo must brave a whirlpool to rescue him.
episodes.title: The Counter Attack

episodes.synopsis: Mia and Sage look for Kento and come up against harsh weather, wild wolves, and a determined Cale.
episodes.title: Splitting the Stone

episodes.synopsis: Ryo and Cye set out to rescue Rowen from Dais, whose illusions turn the warriors against each other.
episodes.title: Friend or Foe

episodes.synopsis: The team splits up to learn what Talpa has planned for Rowen, who is lost somewhere in space.
episodes.title: Wildfire in the Sky

episodes.synopsis: Ryo attempts to break free of the dark matrix while his allies on the ground battle Talpa.
episodes.title: In the Sea of the Sky

episodes.synopsis: Dais lures the heroes into a trap within the castle gates and separates them from their armor.
episodes.title: Assault on the Dynasty

episodes.synopsis: As the heroes approach Talpa's castle, the enemy attacks and succeeds in splitting up the team.
episodes.title: Shallow Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Talpa enacts a plan to turn the heroes to evil based on his knowledge of their armors' dark origins.
episodes.title: Fate of the Ronin Armor

episodes.synopsis: Anubis fights the heroes at an amusement park and a fearful Kento tries to fight without his armor.
episodes.title: Armor of Life

episodes.synopsis: The Ancient One reveals the nature of the mystical armors; Anubis rethinks his loyalty to Talpa.
episodes.title: The Ancient's Battle

episodes.synopsis: The heroes reach Talpa's castle and face the combined might of Talpa's dark forces.
episodes.title: Raid on Talpa's Castle

episodes.synopsis: Talpa dons his warlords' armors to directly attack the heroes and steal their armors for himself.
episodes.title: The Legend of the Armor

episodes.synopsis: Ryo must find a way to defeat Talpa without destroying his captured friends.
episodes.title: Talpa's Triumph

episodes.synopsis: The Ancient One helps Ryo resist Talpa's attempt to absorb him into his armor.
episodes.title: Wildfire's Fight Against Fate

episodes.synopsis: A new threat named Saranbo arrives to claim the Inferno Armor for himself.
episodes.title: Ronin vs. Saranbo

episodes.synopsis: A regretful Ryo abandons the team over Mia's objections to face Saranbo alone.
episodes.title: Ryo's Mega Armor

episodes.synopsis: Lord Saber Stryke and his tiger attack the heroes over possession of powerful swords.
episodes.title: Saber Stryke's Deadly Challenge

episodes.synopsis: With the heroes in need of the Soul Swords, White Blaze risks his life to steal them.
episodes.title: White Blaze's Sacrifice

episodes.synopsis: On the way to investigate a volcano, the heroes encounter a foe who wants to test their strength.
episodes.title: Sun Devil: Ambassador of Evil

episodes.synopsis: Sekhmet creates an evil duplicate of Cye to subdue the real one.
episodes.title: Torrent's Evil Twin

episodes.synopsis: Sage fights a battle of wills when Cale attempts to convince him he is capable of great evil.
episodes.title: The Armor Must Be Destroyed

episodes.synopsis: Kento must learn to rely on more than his brute strength to win fights.
episodes.title: Sand Blasted

episodes.synopsis: Rowen and Ryo encounter Lady Kayura and learn Talpa's forces have captured their friends.
episodes.title: Lady Kayura and the Dark Realm

episodes.synopsis: Ryo and Rowen encounter a familiar face who pledges to help them.
episodes.title: Anubis Is Reborn

episodes.synopsis: Anubis attempts to gain Mia and Ully's trust and explains his past; Talpa creates a new weapon.
episodes.title: Talpa Turns the Tide

episodes.synopsis: Dala attacks Ryo and Rowen with Talpa's new sword, which allows him to use their friends' powers.
episodes.title: Legend of the White Armor

episodes.synopsis: The villains attempt to take control of Ryo's armor, unwittingly revealing another aspect of it.
episodes.title: Strategies of the Nether World

episodes.synopsis: Anubis and Mia come across something important in Mia's grandfather's research.
episodes.title: In Search of Secret Treasures

episodes.synopsis: Mia and Anubis try to puzzle out how to use the Jewel of Life to defeat Anubis.
episodes.title: Strata's Defiant Stand

episodes.synopsis: Rowan sacrifices himself to help Ryo and the others fend off Lady Kayura.
episodes.title: The Warriors Return

episodes.synopsis: Sage and Rowen defend Mia and Ully, who possess the Jewel of Life, from Talpa's minions.
episodes.title: Cheap Tricks

episodes.synopsis: The heroes take a much-needed rest to prepare for the final showdown with Talpa.
episodes.title: Anubis' Armor Revived

episodes.synopsis: Anubis battles a possessed Lady Kayura in the hopes of freeing her from the bonds of evil.
episodes.title: Lady Evil Sees the Light

episodes.synopsis: Lady Kayura and the warlords fight alongside the heroes to stop Talpa before he destroys the world.
episodes.title: Triumphant Warriors
